306:t_007:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units! Now we just have to overpower them head-on! We'll settle this in one push!」

306:t_008:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「Let's hurry. $$アマルガム$$'s pursuit force is coming.」

306:t_008:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「But we'll be in trouble if things keep going like this.」

306:t_008:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「For starters, it's dangerous to keep fighting while nursing our machines along...」

306:t_009:0.en:
$n
「It's a $$サイデリアル$$ transport ship!」

306:t_009:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Did you arrange that transport ship and pilot it yourself?」

306:t_009:4.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「No... I didn't prepare it, and I'm not piloting it.」

306:t_009:7.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Apparently $$ＡＧ$$ is integrated with the ship's control system.」

306:t_009:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right. I can't do it like $$ブライト$$ or $$ジェフリー$$, but I'm counting on your support.」

306:t_009:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「You even arranged a ship! That's our dimensional merchant!」

306:t_009:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm delighted by your praise, but I must give you the latest tragic news.」

306:t_009:13.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...$$メリダ島$$ has fallen to an $$アマルガム$$ attack.」

306:t_010:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn it! W-we'll leave this fight unfinished for now!!」

306:t_011:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Every single time... he says the same thing...」

306:t_011:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$ロジャー$$. Why don't you teach him a little vocabulary?」

306:t_011:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I doubt a crude petty villain like him could master my language.」

306:t_011:3.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「This time, I agree completely.」

306:t_012:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「This is bad... $$アマルガム$$'s main force is coming.」

306:t_012:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「We can't... win with these forces...」

306:t_012:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is this... the end for us...!?」

306:t_100:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You negotiator! You've resorted to brute force. It seems you've lost your job!」

306:t_100:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I can't negotiate with someone who won't listen to words. In that regard, you're scarcely different from the $$バアル$$.」

306:t_100:2.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I've heard enough...! Then I'll crush you with force!」

306:t_101:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you and you! You ruined my tactics, and you wiped out my trump card!」

306:t_101:1.en:
$n
「Sorry about that. To make up for it, I'll make sure you never have to fight again.」

306:t_101:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Hmm... His trash talk has much to teach even me.」

306:t_101:5.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「It hardly seems usable in a proper negotiation, though.」

306:t_102:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$, $$シャッコ$$! The day has finally come to settle our feud!」

306:t_102:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Do you remember how many times he's said that?」

306:t_102:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I don't listen to anything he says in the first place.」

306:t_102:4.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Y-you bastaaard!! That's what I can't stand about youuuu!!」

306:t_103:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You're $$ミスリル$$ survivors! Even if you escape here, only despair awaits you!」

306:t_103:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're all talk as always, $$カン・ユー$$!」

306:t_103:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'll turn that AT you don't deserve into your coffin, so go to sleep already!」

306:t_104:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「The $$黒の騎士団$$ leader, $$ゼロ$$, and the Knight of Zero, two against one? You cowards!」

306:t_104:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Call us cowards all you like.」

306:t_104:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't think the words of someone like you can shake my resolve, my will, or my fight!」

306:t_105:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's fine, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! We've got a grudge against him, too!」

306:t_105:3.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「D-don't tell me you're still angry about being a bunny girl in $$クメン$$!?」

306:t_105:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's not what I'm talking about! I can't forgive your nerve, attacking us as $$アマルガム$$'s lackey!」

306:t_105:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「I just remembered the bunny girl thing! While I'm at it, I'll pay you back for that here, too!」

306:t_105:6.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「S-so you are angry after all!」

306:t_105:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You might be evenly matched when it comes to holding a grudge...」

306:t_106:0.en:
$n
(I'm sorry, $$宗介$$... I couldn't save you and $$千鳥$$...)

306:t_106:1.en:
$n
(But it isn't over yet...! I'll find you, I promise!)

306:t_106:2.en:
$n
(And I'll do it...! I'll rescue $$千鳥$$, no matter what!)

311:t_1:3.en: ～$$マーティアル$$ Church Headquarters　Pope's Office～

311:t_1:4.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「...I've just received a report from our $$クメン$$ branch.」

311:t_1:6.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$... That man is in $$クメン$$ now.」

311:t_1:7.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「...The $$マーティアル$$ Church lost its authority for laying hands on the $$触れ得ざる者$$. Have you still not learned your lesson...?」

311:t_1:8.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Silence, $$ロッチナ$$. Don't forget I only keep you here out of mercy.」

311:t_1:10.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$ジャン・ポール・ロッチナ$$... Tell me my name.」

311:t_1:11.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
「You are His Holiness $$ヴィアチェスラフ・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$, the 713th Pope of the $$マーティアル$$ Church.」

311:t_1:12.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Know that my words are God's words. You may leave.」

311:t_1:13.en:
$$ロッチナ$$
(Has this man become obsessed with $$キリコ$$, too...?)

311:t_1:14.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「...That one is there, too... I'll dispose of them along with $$キリコ$$.」
